stdout: tandem-cli setup install: the bundled agent face, installed and wired.
Writes <TandemHome>/agent/ from the bundled face, links every skill
into ~/.agents/skills and every skill and prompt into each named host,
and adds the host's instruction route. For
opencode it also wires the tandem MCP server into opencode.json, so a
fresh session lists working tools with no manual config. An
absent `--host` is opencode; a comma-separated list names more. A real
file at a host path is never overwritten; a link pointing elsewhere, a
checkout included, is left alone unless `--force`. One JSON report;
exit 1 when a warning is an error, the report still on stdout.
